description: This file defines an enumeration (enum) for different types of client transactions within the Fineract project. It provides a set of transaction types with associated integer values and string codes, along with utility methods to convert from integers and retrieve enum bounds.

classes.name: ClientTransactionType
classes.description: An enum representing different types of client transactions, with associated integer values and string codes. Contains utility methods for conversion and bounds retrieval.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the transaction type.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the transaction type.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to its corresponding ClientTransactionType enum, if exists.

methods.name: getMinValue
methods.description: Returns the minimum integer value among the transaction types.

methods.name: getMaxValue
methods.description: Returns the maximum integer value among the transaction types.
